extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and on chrome://extensions.

extShortName.description: Short extension name for cramped surfaces. Chrome truncates past 12 characters.

extDescription.message: Track Google Meet attendance on a timeline: series, attendance matrix, PDF & CSV reports, analytics, dark mode, Google Sheets sync.
extDescription.description: Chrome Web Store description. Chrome truncates past 132 characters.

liveNowHint.message: This call is running right now — its figures move with it.

liveNowOne.description: Title of the masthead marker when exactly one meeting is live.

liveNowMany.description: Title of the masthead marker when several meetings are live.

unfinishedHint.message: Nothing ended this meeting — the browser closed, or tracking stopped mid-call. It stops at its last sign of life, $TIME$, and everyone still shown in the call is still standing in it.
unfinishedHint.description: Explains the marker on a meeting that was never closed.

confirmEndNow.message: End this meeting at $TIME$, its last sign of life? Anyone still shown in the call is marked as having left then.
confirmEndNow.description: Asked before closing a meeting nothing got to end.

endedNowToast.message: Ended at its last sign of life

selCount.description: Number of rows currently selected in a list.

rosterAddedToast.description: Confirmation after adding people to the roster.

rosterRemovedToast.description: Confirmation after removing people from the roster.

confirmDeleteMeetings.description: Confirmation prompt before deleting the selected meetings.

unarchivedMeetingsToast.description: Confirmation after restoring meetings from the archive.

trashLeftDays.description: How long a meeting in the trash has left.

emptyTrashBody.message: A deleted meeting waits here until its retention window runs out. Until then you can put it back.

trashedToast.description: Confirmation after moving meetings to the trash.

restoredToast.description: Confirmation after restoring meetings from the trash.

purgedToast.description: Confirmation after deleting meetings for good.

confirmPurge.message: Delete $COUNT$ meetings for good? This cannot be undone.
confirmPurge.description: Prompt before deleting meetings for good.

confirmEmptyTrash.message: Empty the trash ($COUNT$)? This cannot be undone.

settingTrashHint.message: How many days a deleted meeting waits in the trash before it goes for good.

pagerRange.description: Which slice of a paged list is on screen.

emptyMeetingsBody.message: Join a Google Meet and Attendance Tracker starts the register automatically.

emptyMeetingsArchiveBody.message: A meeting you are done with goes here, from the archive icon beside its name.

timelineHint.message: every join & leave on the meeting clock

hoursPinnedTitle.message: Meeting hours set by hand — click to edit

hoursAutoTitle.message: Hours from the tracked activity — click to set them by hand

scheduleHint.message: Attendance share is measured against these hours. They come from the calendar event when Meet shows it — otherwise from when tracking started, which is why opening the call early can understate everyone.

scheduleObserved.description: The scheduled time window detected from the calendar event.

scheduleInvalid.message: The end must be after the start

editParticipantHint.message: Fix the display name — or enter another participant’s name to merge the two entries into one person.

mergeWarning.message: Will merge with “$NAME$” — the joins and leaves of both entries become one person.
mergeWarning.description: Warning shown before merging a duplicate participant into another name.

mergedFromTitle.description: Tooltip listing the original names merged into this person.

archiveSubtitle.message: Series set aside. They keep all of their data, but stay out of the way when a meeting is added to a series.

archiveGroup.message: Move the series to the archive

unarchiveGroup.message: Restore the series from the archive

emptyArchiveBody.message: A series that has run its course goes here, from the archive icon beside its name.

emptyGroupsBody.message: Bundle recurring sessions — like a weekend training — into one series to see who attended all of it.

seriesSuggestBody.message: $COUNT$ sessions share the same Meet link.
seriesSuggestBody.description: Offers to group meetings that look like one recurring series.

groupThese.description: Button that groups the suggested meetings into a series.

sessionsN.description: Plural session count. The singular form is sessionsOne.

peopleN.description: Plural people count. The singular form is peopleOne.

groupRosterHint.message: Anyone here who misses a session is marked absent for that session.

groupSessionsHint.message: open one for its own timeline

pickMeetingsHint.message: Tick the meetings that belong here. One already in another series moves over.

pickMeetingsEmpty.message: Every meeting is already in this series

meetingsAddedToast.description: Confirmation after adding meetings to a series from the series page.

personSessionsTitle.description: Heading above one person's presence across every session.

confirmDeleteGroup.message: Delete this series? The meetings themselves are kept.

emptyPeopleBody.message: Once you track a meeting, everyone who attended shows up here.

personMeetingsN.description: Number of meetings a person attended.

analyticsSubtitle.message: Trends, rhythm and attendance across a slice of your meetings

pickSelected.description: Applies an action to the currently selected rows.

summaryMeetings.description: Meeting count in an analytics summary.

summaryPeople.description: People count in an analytics summary.

analyticsNoneBody.message: Widen the range or clear the filters to see meetings again.

kpiVsPrev.message: vs the previous period of the same length

kpiNoPrev.message: No data for the previous period

chartShareHint.message: how much of a meeting people sit through

insightAttendedOf.description: How many of the analysed meetings a person attended.

insightShareOf.description: A person's average attendance share across their meetings.

emptyAnalyticsBody.message: Track a few meetings and trends appear here.

settingTrackingHint.message: Start the register automatically when you join a Google Meet.

settingThemeHint.message: System follows your browser’s light/dark preference.

settingLanguageHint.message: Interface language. Automatic follows your browser.

settingRosterHint.message: Expected attendees for standalone meetings. Series keep their own roster.

rosterPlaceholder.message: Type a name and press Enter

rosterPasteHint.message: One name per line, or separated by commas.

sheetsHint.message: Keep a copy of the register in a spreadsheet of your own and get it back from there.

sheetsStepDataHint.message: The sheet holds all the meeting data, so it can serve as a backup. Auto-sync sends finished meetings and brings back any the sheet has that are missing here. Neither side ever loses a record: what the sheet already holds can only be changed or removed in Google Sheets, and a meeting deleted here stays deleted.

sheetsLastSync.description: Shown under step 3 of the Google Sheets setup.

spreadsheetRefPlaceholder.message: Paste a link to the sheet, or its ID

sheetsOpenNote.message: Open the sheet in Google Sheets

sheetsPushedToast.description: Confirmation after sending meetings to Google Sheets.

sheetsPushNothingNew.message: Nothing new — the sheet already has everything that ended

sheetsPushKept.message: $COUNT$ meetings are already in the sheet, so they were left exactly as they were sent — nothing here rewrites or removes what the sheet holds. To change the copy up there, edit it in Google Sheets, or create a new sheet and send everything to that one.
sheetsPushKept.description: Advice under step 3 when Send everything skipped meetings the sheet already had.

sheetsPushRunning.message: $COUNT$ meetings are still running. They go up once they end, because a call written mid-way could never be corrected afterwards.
sheetsPushRunning.description: Advice under step 3 when Send everything held back meetings that had not ended.

sheetsPushFailed.message: Could not write to the sheet

sheetsRestoredToast.description: Confirmation after restoring meetings from Google Sheets.

sheetsRestoreKept.message: $COUNT$ meetings from the sheet are already here and were left as they are, edits and all. To take the sheet's copy of one instead, delete it here, remove it from the trash, and restore again.
sheetsRestoreKept.description: Advice under step 3 when a restore skipped meetings already in the register.

sheetsRestoreTrashed.message: $COUNT$ meetings from the sheet are in the trash here, so they stayed deleted — the sheet keeps its copy either way. Bring them back from the trash if you want them again.
sheetsRestoreTrashed.description: Advice under step 3 when a restore skipped meetings sitting in the trash.

sheetsPulledToast.message: Brought in from the sheet: $COUNT$ meetings
sheetsPulledToast.description: Confirmation after an automatic sync found meetings recorded elsewhere.

sheetsNoBackup.message: Nothing to restore — send everything to this sheet first

confirmSheetsRestore.message: Add everything stored in the sheet? Meetings already here are kept as they are.

autoSync.message: Keep the sheet and this list in step

importHint.message: Merge a JSON backup or a CSV exported from here (existing meetings are kept).

importAppsHint.message: Convert a backup from another attendance extension and merge it in.

maxMeetingsHint.message: Older meetings beyond this are dropped. Unlimited keeps every meeting.

clearAllHint.message: Remove every stored meeting. Cannot be undone.

confirmClearAll.message: Delete ALL stored meetings? This cannot be undone.

confirmSheetsDisconnect.message: Disconnect Google account and forget the sheet?

importedToast.description: Confirmation after importing meetings from a file.

importInvalid.message: That file isn’t a valid backup

importedConvertedToast.description: Confirmation after importing meetings converted from another tool's export.

importSourceInvalid.message: That file doesn’t look like a $SOURCE$ backup
importSourceInvalid.description: Error when the file does not match the selected import source.

importNothingNew.message: Nothing new — those meetings are already here

addedNamesMany.description: Confirmation after pasting several names into the roster.

sheetsRefRequired.message: Paste a link to the spreadsheet, or its ID

reportGenerated.description: Timestamp printed in the footer of a PDF report.

reportNotFoundBody.message: This meeting is no longer in storage.

popupNoMeeting.message: Open a Google Meet to start
